topology_analysis.function: Split optical signal from one input waveguide into two output waveguides with equal power distribution
key_features: Wide MMI region in center (multimode interference region)
Tapered transitions between waveguides and MMI region
Horizontal stripes visible in MMI region (likely interference pattern visualization or cladding layers)

function_defining_parameters.mmi_width: Width of the central MMI region (critical for interference pattern)
function_defining_parameters.mmi_length: Length of MMI region (determines self-imaging length)
function_defining_parameters.input_taper_length: Length of taper from input waveguide to MMI
function_defining_parameters.output_taper_length: Length of taper from MMI to output waveguides
function_defining_parameters.input_taper_width: Width at MMI end of input taper
function_defining_parameters.output_taper_width: Width at MMI end of output tapers
function_defining_parameters.output_separation: Vertical spacing between two output waveguides

topology_analysis.construction_approach: Use straights for waveguides, tapers for transitions, and a wide rectangle for the MMI region. The horizontal stripes appear to be interior features (possibly cladding) - will need to create multiple parallel rectangles with gaps to match this pattern.

iterations.change_made: Initial attempt - vertical MMI with solid blocks. WRONG: device is horizontal (120×4 μm), stripes are gaps not material overlays
Horizontal orientation but missing bundled regions. Need 3 vertically-stacked groups, each with: left bundle → fan → parallel wg → fan → right bundle. Total 120 μm wide.
Three-group structure with correct size (120×4). Issues: bundle_width too large, fan transitions overlap, center waveguides misaligned. Need thinner bundles, better fan geometry.
Thinner bundles (0.65), no taper width change. Good middle group. Issues: too short (3.24 vs 4.0), missing bundle material on edges, excess in center. Need larger group_gap, wider bundles.
Increased bundle_width to 0.85, group_gap to 0.35. Good vertical size (3.94) but too much bundle material (red). Worse than iter 4. Try middle ground.
Middle ground: bundle_width=0.73, group_gap=0.28. Still worse than iter 4. BEST: iter 4 with IoU=0.559.
